authorization: Explicit Owner authorization in the J8 instruction, 2026-11-16, for bounded FEM diagnostic calculations.

input.solver: Hex8SRIElement from the frozen main solver source tree

shared: nine end-face nodes receive equal z force
controlled_contrast.single_changed_factor: coordinate mapping distortion: regular structured coordinates in the new case versus the exact J7 near_degenerate_valid mapping in the archived comparison case
controlled_contrast.important_geometry_note: This changes the represented physical cross-section as well as element shape: the near-degenerate coordinate map uses z=0.04*z_nominal+0.006*(x/L)*(y-0.5*width), while the control spans the nominal 1 m height. Interpret the contrast as a geometry-map effect, not as pure mesh-quality variation on an identical body.

objectives: hold material, nominal dimensions, mesh counts, force distribution, and fixed DOFs constant while changing only the coordinate map
compare actual geometric extents, Gauss Jacobians, positive definiteness, eigenvalue condition estimate, backward residual, reactions, force and moment closure, and energy terms
determine whether geometry mapping can explain part of the condition-number difference between the J7 cases without claiming formulation correctness

predeclared_metrics.actual_geometry: report coordinate min/max and extents from generated regular coordinates and archived near-degenerate coordinates; do not infer physical dimensions only from nominal input fields
predeclared_metrics.jacobian: report min/max of all 2x2x2 HEX8 Gauss-point determinants in m^3; require finite and strictly positive
predeclared_metrics.matrix: report relative Frobenius symmetry, min/max eigenvalues of Kff, and kappa2 estimate when lambda_min>0; require symmetry <= 1e-12 and positive definiteness before solve
predeclared_metrics.solution: one binary64 numpy.linalg.solve of the free partition; report free residual, normwise backward error, displacement difference from archived near-degenerate case only as descriptive because the geometry differs
predeclared_metrics.equilibrium: compute reactions from K*u-f on constrained DOFs, then report force closure in N and moment closure at the origin in N m
predeclared_metrics.energy: report U=0.5*u^T*K*u, W=0.5*u^T*f in J, historical SI normalization, and unit-covariant eta_E; no acceptance threshold
predeclared_metrics.load: check summed nodal force against (0,0,-1) N with the frozen applied-load tolerance 1e-14

execution.semantics: The runner enforces timeout/output caps and samples RSS/process/temp/archive as soft controls; it is not an OS resource quota.

limits: the contrast changes the represented cross-section height and warp, so it does not isolate element aspect ratio independently of physical geometry
only one new regular control is solved; the archived J7 case is reused as the distorted comparison
the comparison reuses the same HEX8-SRI formulation in both cases and cannot establish its physical accuracy or exclude a common formulation defect
no historical J7 metric, verdict, or attempt ledger is changed
